backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles plus encrypted events and tasks with per‑user maps and access‑control checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark color palettes and global styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/api/calendarMutations.ts: React Query mutations for encrypted event/task creation, updates, deletion, and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/api/calendarQueries.ts: React Query hooks fetching and decrypting events and tasks using the backend actor and encryption key.
Helpers for encrypting/decrypting event and task fields and mapping encrypted models to plaintext models.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app controlling auth, profile setup, passphrase unlock, and rendering the main shell.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen showing security info and triggering Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting user for their name and saving the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/crypto/Passphras: Modal for entering a passphrase to unlock encryption, showing errors and allowing logout.
frontend/src/components/layout/Shell.tsx: Main app shell showing header, tabs for events/tasks, and lock/logout actions.
frontend/src/crypto/cryptoTypes.ts: Type definitions for encrypted payloads and stored user salts.
frontend/src/crypto/useEncryptionSession: Zustand-based hook managing encryption key state, unlocking via passphrase-derived keys.
frontend/src/crypto/webCrypto.ts: WebCrypto utilities for key derivation, AES-GCM encrypt/decrypt, and salt storage.
frontend/src/features/events/EventCard.t: Displays a single event with edit/delete actions and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/features/events/EventFormDi: Dialog for creating or editing events, handling validation and submission.
Shows event list with loading/error states and a button to create new events.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TaskCard.tsx: Displays a task with completion toggle, edit and delete controls, and optional deadline/details.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TaskFormDial: Form dialog for creating or editing tasks, handling title, details, and optional deadlines.
frontend/src/features/tasks/TasksView.ts: Loads and displays all tasks, separating active and completed ones, and provides a button to create new tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication, storing identity state and handling login, logout, and initialization.
frontend/src/index.css: Re-exports global stylesheet from the parent directory.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, container settings, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, existing features, and pending feature requests for an encrypted calendar application.
